Approach

Retailers manage thousands, often millions, of products, constantly shifting customer demand, inventory constraints, promotional campaigns, and seasonal trends. Yet many of the systems powering online shopping were built for a simpler era.

Malachyte was founded on a simple belief: commerce decisions should be intelligent, adaptive, and aligned with the goals of the business.

Our Origin

##### In industries like music and video, vector-based AI changed how people discover content by understanding taste, context, and intent, helping millions of people find exactly what they were looking for, often before they knew it themselves.

##### Yet when the team looked at ecommerce technology, they saw an industry still relying on outdated systems built around rules, static segments, and disconnected tools.

##### Retailers were being asked to operate incredibly complex businesses using technology that lacked the intelligence to keep up.

##### Malachyte was created to change that.

The Principle Behind Malachyte

##### We believe ecommerce technology should do more than react to customer behavior, it should proactively anticipate their wants and needs. It should help retailers make better decisions.

##### Every product interaction, from search results to recommendations to merchandising, represents an opportunity to balance two forces:

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/PxgRRfEOkP5BS7FnSLPGNn8jBkY.png?width=1366&height=696)

##### When those two signals work together, retailers create experiences that are not only more relevant for shoppers, but also more effective for the business. By drawing from advances in modern AI modeling, Malachyte brings a new approach to ecommerce intelligence. Our platform applies vector-based learning techniques, similar to those used in large-scale content discovery systems, to understand relationships between products, shoppers, and behavior. Instead of relying on rigid rules or static segmentation, the system continuously learns and adapts as shopper behavior evolves.

##### The goal isn’t just better recommendations. It’s helping retailers align product discovery with business strategy.

## Where We're Going

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/AE7EFAyvU9tLcipfB3vleqW5uTY.png?width=1088&height=964)

The Future of Commerce Intelligence

##### Today, Malachyte powers smarter product discovery across ecommerce experiences. But the long-term vision is bigger. The same intelligence that helps determine what products appear in search or recommendations can also inform decisions across merchandising, marketing, inventory planning, and product strategy. Malachyte is building the intelligence layer that helps retailers turn data into better decisions across the entire business.

##### Building the intelligence layer that powers the future of commerce.
